title: The Bell Jar
author: Sylvia Plath
summary: Esther Greenwood, a gifted college student on an internship at a New York magazine, begins to feel numb and shut off from everything around her. Her slide into depression leads to a stay in psychiatric care.
readIf: you want a sharp, honest and darkly funny novel about depression and the pressure put on young women.
skipIf: you are in a fragile place or would find suicide attempts difficult to read.

pairings.reason: Another classic of a bright young narrator who feels alienated from the adult world.
A younger, more hopeful story of a girl who withdraws and slowly finds her voice.
A story of psychiatric care from a different angle, more political and rebellious.
